monitoring_summary: 26 confirmed declining sellers and 20 on watch on meesho as of 2026-09-08. Main problem areas among confirmed sellers: Marketing (12), Logistics (5), Finance (4), Inventory (3), Customer Experience (1), Seller support (1).
monitoring_notes_from_llm: Investigations into multiple sellers revealed that marketing issues, such as declining listing quality and poor ad returns, frequently catalyzed severe customer experience degradation including higher return rates and negative reviews. Additionally, some sellers suffered from inventory strains and significant support slowdowns.

action_plans.internal_summary: Seller S0011 is experiencing a critical decline driven by deteriorating listing quality and inaccurate product content, which has dropped listing scores and diminished ad efficiency. This catalog degradation caused a knock-on effect in Customer Experience, depressing customer ratings and driving up returns as buyers receive items that do not match descriptions. The surge in complaints has also overwhelmed Seller Support, leading to longer response times.

actions.action: Contact the seller about the marketing problem and offer support
Audit the top listings by order volume, restore images and required attributes, and stop bulk uploads until the template is checked.
Review the flagged listings, correct claims and images, and re-submit them.
Pause the worst-performing ads, move the budget to the best listings by conversion, and review price against comparable products.

seller_message.subject: Important update regarding your product listings and customer experience
seller_message.body: We have noticed that your product listing quality appears to have dropped recently, which may be affecting customer satisfaction and your advertising return. To help improve your performance, we recommend auditing your top listings by order volume to restore missing images and required attributes, as well as correcting any inaccurate descriptions or images on your listings. Please also pause any underperforming ads and shift your budget to top-converting products. We are here to help if you need guidance on updating your catalog or improving ad efficiency.

action_plans.escalate_if: Escalate if listing quality scores continue to drop and return rates increase further after the seller has attempted to update their catalog and ad campaigns.
